card.summary: No free tier and no trial is published; the cheapest entry is S100G at EUR 15.96 per year, about EUR 1.33 per month.

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial is published; the cheapest entry is S100G at EUR 15.96 per year, about EUR 1.33 per month.

per_object_cap.stated: 200 GB per torrent on every plan ('Storage | 200GB / torrent'), which is the per-torrent working set rather than the box's total
per_object_cap.notes: the table prints 200GB/torrent as a row for every tier, so the cap is per object, not per account

retention.stated: for the life of the subscription; 'We do not keep records or logs' is a logging claim, not a retention limit

egress.terms: 'Upload traffic: unmetered' and 'Download traffic: unmetered' on a 1Gbit+ network; 'you can download it through FTP(S), HTTP(S) on your house computer'.

record.interface_detail: 'you can download it through FTP(S), HTTP(S) on your house computer'; sharing direct download allowed over HTTPS.
record.tooling: FTP/FTPS clients and a browser for HTTP(S); TorrentCLOUD web interface; no API or CLI is documented
record.chaining: The cheapest live seedbox found among debrid providers at EUR 1.33/month for a 200 GB working set; unmetered, so 1 TiB of monthly transfer is a matter of cycling torrents, not of quota

limits.value: 1 Gbit+ shared; 2 active torrents on the entry plan (4/7/10/14 on larger plans)

record.limits_note: The active-torrent count is the real brake on the entry plan: two at a time, each up to 200 GB, so 1 TiB of monthly transfer is roughly five sequential cycles. The vocabulary has no kind for a simultaneous-torrent cap.
record.binding_note: At 1 TiB/month the 200 GB-per-torrent working set and the 2-active-torrent count decide throughput; no byte quota exists to fail first.

identity_cost.detail: Account plus payment (BitCoin, credit card, iDEAL, Sofort, Bancontact, bank transfer); no free tier. No phone or document check is stated.

record.reliability_note: Two active torrents on the entry plan and 200 GB per torrent; the vendor states no logs, which is unverifiable.
record.confidence_note: Price, caps, protocols and payment methods are on the live vendor page read. A measured rung needs a slot and a timed transfer.

evidence.proved: S100G EUR 15.96/year; S300G EUR 4.30/m; S600G EUR 7.18/m; S900G EUR 10.05/m; S1200G EUR 12.93/m; '200GB / torrent'; 2/4/7/10/14 active torrents; unmetered upload and download; 1Gbit+; FTP(S)/HTTP(S)

record.notes: The annual-only entry is the cheapest live offer debrid verified: EUR 1.33/month. Sustained-rate conversion: unmetered, so the comparable number is the 1 Gbit+ port, 125 MB/s theoretical; at 1 TiB/month the requirement is only 3.39 Mbit/s, so the port is irrelevant and the 2-torrent count is the real constraint. Potential constraints: annual prepayment, the 2-torrent cap, or a hidden fair-use rule; the first two are on the page, the third is not.

extras.minimum_term: entry is annual (EUR 15.96/year); larger plans monthly with discounts for 3/6/12 months
extras.apps: TorrentCLOUD web interface (Transmission backend), FTP(S)/HTTP(S) download; no Plex, *arr or VPN is stated on the page read
